title: The Twin Mirror Spirit Canon
summary: A canon of two mirrors of feeling set face to face that ends in a reflection no spirit can look away from.

title: Treatise of Paired Hearts
summary: A treatise on holding two hearts in step so that the feeling of one answers the feeling of the other.

title: Hawk and Azure Spirit Mastery
summary: A mastery of the far-seeing spirit that reads a whole field from above and drops on its weakest heart.

title: The Basin of Gathered Feeling
summary: A canon that gathers the feeling of a crowd like water in a basin and lets it run out as one force.

title: The Oath of the Open Ear
summary: A canon of the oath to hear every spirit near and to answer them truly in the gale of a fight.

title: Plateau Spirit Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of the spirit as a high open plain from which every approaching feeling is seen long before it arrives.

title: Mastery of the Wind-Carried Mood
summary: A mastery of sending a mood on the wind to a distant spirit and receiving its answer.

title: The Sworn Bearing of Spirits
summary: A canon of a bearing sworn once toward every spirit met so that none can turn the user from true feeling.
